jobs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production replacement sprite sheet for a medieval painted RPG. Reference image 1 is the old WALL to redesign. Reference image 2 is a cottage, MATERIAL/ART STYLE reference only. Create a heavier, elegant ash-grey stone city rampart module, with solid dressed-stone courses, modest crenellations, shallow projecting stone buttresses and dark iron details. Rich hand-painted realistic adult RPG style, matching the grey stone and amber lighting of the cottage. No timber scaffold look. One straight modular wall panel, 7 metres long, 3 metres high, 0.6 metre thick. Continuous masonry end faces designed to butt against adjacent modules; no isolated elaborate terminal pillars. Precisely four views of THE SAME MODULE arranged separately in 2x2 equal cells on transparent background. All verticals upright. Top-left: front along screen down-right ground axis, long base slopes +0.47. Top-right: quarter turn front along screen up-right ground axis, long base slopes -1.06 and consequently narrower screen width. Bottom-left: back view along down-right ground axis +0.47. Bottom-right: back view along up-right ground axis -1.06. Orthographic elevated camera at approximately 45 degrees elevation, fixed world lighting from upper left, NOT perspective convergence. Each entire object centered in its own cell, 8% clear transparent margin around every cell. No floor patch, no cast shadow outside asset, no people, no labels, no text, no layout scenery. Crisp clean transparency without colored fringe. It must read as a continuous fortification, not a decorative garden fence.

Use case: stylized-concept. Production replacement sprite sheet for a medieval painted RPG. Reference image 1 is the old GATE to improve; image 2 cottage establishes materials and painterly style. Redesign as an impressive yet compact city gateway matching ash-grey dressed-stone fortifications: two sturdy square stone towers, dark slate pyramidal caps, generous clear open arch for travel, raised black iron portcullis, small warm amber lanterns, subtle aged bronze crest, restrained charcoal banners. Solid crafted architecture, refined proportions, no excessive tiny decorations. Footprint across passage 10 metres wide and 2.4 metres deep, arch roughly 5 metres clear; height roughly 7 metres. Painted realistic adult RPG, grey weathered stone, natural dark oak and black iron, same warmth and detail as reference cottage. Four consistent views of ONE gate in equal 2x2 transparent cells. Fixed elevated orthographic camera, verticals upright. Top-left front along screen down-right ground axis: line connecting tower ground centres slopes +0.47. Top-right quarter turn front along screen up-right axis: tower ground centres slope -1.06, thus gate appears narrower from this view. Bottom-left back along down-right +0.47, showing winch/wood beam mechanism. Bottom-right back along up-right -1.06. Same geometry every view, consistent scale. Whole asset fully inside each cell with 8% clear margins. Absolutely transparent through open arch and outside. No floor tile, no surrounding walls, no characters, no text or labels. Design outer tower sides to accept connecting wall modules around half the tower height.

Use case: stylized-concept. NEW production RPG sprite of a beautiful CITY EXIT WARP CORE. Reference image 1 cottage is material/rendering style; reference image 2 existing portal is compatible stone/bronze/rune design. Make a compact striking waystone: a tall luminous pale turquoise / cyan floating faceted crystal, suspended upright between three curved blackened iron and antique bronze prongs, on a low round ash-grey carved stone plinth with a thin turquoise rune ring. A few tiny suspended crystal motes close to core, tasteful soft glow contained near silhouette. Roughly adult human height 2.4 metres and 1.6 metres diameter. Easily recognized as travel portal next to a medieval city gate. Detailed hand-painted realistic RPG, weathered grey stone, dark metal, warm bronze highlights, refined clear silhouette. Create four directional views of THE SAME core in 2x2 equal cells, actual rotations about vertical axis 0,90,180,270, same fixed orthographic elevated camera and lighting, natural asymmetry of 3 support prongs helps read directions. All verticals upright and complete. Cell order TL front right, TR front left, BL rear right, BR rear left. 10% clear margin in each cell. Genuinely transparent background, transparent gaps between metal prongs. No floor patch, no scenery, no large circular ground portal, no character, no text, no labels, no opaque glow rectangle. Keep magical light clean and elegant, not a giant neon beam.
